briefing.headline: AI and chip stocks had their worst week since 2020 after Anthropic's Nasdaq debut and a sharp Nvidia sell-off, and the stock market entered correction territory.

points.text: The stock market entered correction territory on Friday as investors grew worried about AI stocks.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic made a record Nasdaq debut. Nvidia then closed out its longest weekly losing streak since 2008.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's stock fell sharply this week. Coverage says it dropped 48%, and it faces an SEC probe.
points.label: reported

points.text: Micron fell 24% and CoreWeave fell 26% in one week.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia reports earnings after the US close on Tuesday, about 1:20am Wednesday in Dubai. Broadcom reports on December 9.
